title: Damage Step in the Shrink Percentage for Broken and Damaged Kernels
content:
Damaged kernels break up in the leg, so the shrink percentage carries a damage step under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements. It is read from the damage on the member's own scale ticket in the grain ledger kept under Grain Marketing Contracts, and from the grade the agreement stands at.

## Clause

Where the scale ticket shows damage above the damage threshold of 3.0 percent and the grade of record stands below US No. 2, the damage step of 0.09 of a percentage point is added to the percentage.

Where the scale ticket shows damage above the damage threshold, or the grade of record stands below US No. 2, the light damage step of 0.04 of a percentage point is added.

And otherwise no step is added for damage.

## What counts as standing below US No. 2

A grade of record of US No. 3 or of sample grade stands below US No. 2. A grade of record of US No. 2 or better does not.

## The combinations in full

| Damage on the scale ticket | Grade of record | Step added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| above 3.0 percent | US No. 3 or sample grade | 0.09 |
| above 3.0 percent | US No. 2 or better | 0.04 |
| 3.0 percent or below | US No. 3 or sample grade | 0.04 |
| 3.0 percent or below | US No. 2 or better | none |

The damage reading is taken strictly above: damage of exactly 3.0 percent is not above the threshold.

## Worked steps, on hypothetical readings

**Damage of 4.6 percent with a grade of record of sample grade.** Both limbs stand, so 0.09 is added.

**Damage of 4.6 percent with a grade of record of US No. 1.** Only the damage limb stands, so 0.04 is added.

**Damage of 1.1 percent with a grade of record of US No. 3.** Only the grade limb stands, so 0.04 is added.

**Damage of 3.0 percent exactly with a grade of record of US No. 2.** Neither limb stands, so no step is added for damage.
